errors.text_span: a green line with circular markers and a blue dashed line with square markers
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the marker shapes for the two lines. The green line has square markers, and the blue dashed line has circular markers.
The blue line at a frequency of 9 reaches an accuracy of approximately 0.99, which is clearly below the 1.0 line on the chart.
The blue line at a frequency of 13 dips to an accuracy of approximately 0.89-0.90, as its marker is visibly below the 0.9 grid line. The value 0.92 is an overestimation.
The green line at frequency 13 is at an accuracy of exactly 0.60, not 0.59.
